summary: Comprehensive testing of Referral System. Backend: 15/15 tests passed - all referral endpoints working correctly. Frontend: Referral page renders correctly for both guest and authenticated users with all features functional.

issues: Clipboard API throws permission error in automated testing environment - this is expected browser security behavior, not a bug. The toast notification still appears correctly.

GET_REFERRAL_MY.description: Returns referral_code, referral_link, total_invited, total_completed, total_earnings, invited_list. Requires auth (401 without token).

POST_REFERRAL_CUSTOMIZE.description: Allows user to set custom referral code (3-15 alphanumeric chars). Validates length and character restrictions. Returns updated code and link.

GET_REFERRAL_LEADERBOARD.description: Public endpoint returning array of top referrers with rank, username, referral_code, referrals count. Currently empty (no completed referrals).

REGISTER_WITH_REFERRAL.description: Creates pending referral record when valid code provided. Referrer's invited count increases. Invalid codes are silently ignored.

ADMIN_REFERRAL_STATS.description: Admin-only endpoint returning total_referrals, completed, pending, total_paid, conversion_rate, top_referrers.

FRONTEND_GUEST_VIEW.description: Guest users see hero section with £3/£2 bonus info, gift icon, and 'Inregistreaza-te' CTA button linking to /login.

FRONTEND_AUTH_VIEW.description: Authenticated users see: stats cards (Invitati, Finalizati, Castigat), referral code display, copy link button, WhatsApp share button, customize button, how it works section, invited friends list.

CUSTOMIZE_CODE_FLOW.description: Click Personalizeaza -> input field appears -> type new code -> save -> 'Cod actualizat!' toast appears -> code updates.

COPY_LINK_BUTTON.description: Copy link button triggers clipboard API and shows 'Link copiat!' toast. Works correctly (clipboard permission error in automated test is expected browser security).

WHATSAPP_SHARE_BUTTON.description: WhatsApp button is visible and enabled, opens wa.me share URL with pre-filled message containing referral code and link.

HOW_IT_WORKS_SECTION.description: 3-step guide displayed: PASUL 1 (Trimite Link-ul), PASUL 2 (Prietenul se Inscrie), PASUL 3 (Ambii Castigati!)

INVITED_FRIENDS_LIST.description: Shows list of invited friends with username, date, and status (In asteptare/Finalizat). Shows '2 total' count.

LEADERBOARD_SECTION.description: Leaderboard section only shows when there are completed referrals. Currently hidden (all referrals are pending).

critical_code_review_comments: Referral system is well-implemented with £3 referrer / £2 referred bonus structure
Referral code customization has proper validation (3-15 chars, alphanumeric only)
Pending referrals are created on registration, completed on first purchase (bonus distributed)
Leaderboard correctly shows only completed referrals (empty when all pending)
Frontend has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Romanian language support is complete throughout the referral page
seed_data_creation: Created test users with referral codes during backend testing (TEST_ prefixed)
